seed_policy: Exact-checked recorded and constructive allocations; same initial seed for both backends at each target. Each backend reuses its feasibility incumbent for worst-loss optimisation. Completed target allocations are available to later targets; target order is recorded.
method: Separate feasibility and worst-loss stages; no Monte Carlo.
limitations: Fixed integer budget and selected legal catalogue only. Numerical solver evidence is distinguished from exact mathematical certificates by optimality_evidence. Feasibility is not worst-loss optimality. Unavailable backends and unresolved time limits remain explicit.
